#### Curve comparison:

+-------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
|                         | **Oxygen**                                                   | **Carbon dioxide**                  |
+=========================+==============================================================+=====================================+
| Shape                   | Sigmoid (law of mass action + co-operative binding)          | Linear                              |
+-------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
| Slope                   | Shallower                                                    | Steeper                             |
|                         |                                                              |                                     |
|                         | - Large a-v difference in pO~2~                              | - Small a-v difference in pCO~2~    |
|                         | - Large ↓PaO~2~ in shunt                                     | - Small ↑PaCO~2~ in shunt           |
+-------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
| Shift                   | Right shift → ↓affinity if:                                  | Left shift → ↑affinity if:          |
|                         |                                                              |                                     |
|                         | - ↑H^+^, ↑pCO~2~ (Bohr effect)                               | - ↓SO~2~ (Haldane effect)           |
|                         | - ↑\[2,3-DPG\]                                               |                                     |
|                         | - ↑Temp                                                      |                                     |
+-------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
| Upper section           | Flat                                                         | Linear                              |
|                         |                                                              |                                     |
| - Implication for shunt | - ↑V~A~ and ↑PiO~2~ cause minimal improvement in oxygenation | - ↑V~A~ easily restores ventilation |
+-------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
